cannotProve: Real app geometry — but this is now covered by marketplace-detail-parity-live.json, which measured height 43/42 on the deployed app. Keep this script for the cases where the app cannot start at all; the heights here (42/46) are still not comparable because the fixture has no icon font.
That the official app computes the same values — the expected values are transcribed from earlier official 0.66 measurements, not measured in this run.
Any property other than padding / textContent / childCount on these two elements.
The other 43 lifted rules. All 45 are parsed and injected into the fixture (including the three pseudo-selector entries), but only the two inline-padding ones are asserted here.
defectsFoundInAnEarlierRevisionOfThisScr: It read .build/fidelity/app/dist/renderer/assets/ while its own header said DEPLOYED. Those were byte-identical only by coincidence (sha ca9b4475e5898b17) because .build had not been rewritten. It now reads the asar and prints its sha256.
It hardcoded the two lifted rules instead of reading LIFTED_OFFICIAL_RULES, so a source-side regression would have measured green. It now parses the real list.

Its first parser matched only two-element entries and read 42 of 45, silently dropping the three :focus-visible / ::after rules. It now counts entry openings independently and refuses to measure on a mismatch.
